result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position by providing up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, a machine-readable data return within 30 days, and written deletion certification. However, it goes beyond what is needed by covering all Works and Confidential Information and by triggering return and deletion upon termination of any individual Statement of Work. That trigger could require deletion of data needed for other continuing Statements of Work. It also conflicts with subsection (c), which conditions delivery of Works in progress on final payment, whereas subsection (d) requires return within 30 days regardless of payment. These overextensions and inconsistencies make the redline non-minimal and risk altering existing commercial intent.
